notes: Six UBC Sauder per-year 'UBC PhD Alumni YYYY' pages (1988, 1991, 1992, 1993, 1994, 1996), each with two Common Crawl captures (Nov 2017 and Nov 2018) whose listings are identical. The year in each page title/URL is not explained on the page (alumni grouped by year, almost certainly the PhD completion year), so yearMeaning is recorded as 'unstated'; the integrator may treat it as graduation year if the parent Alumni index page says so. The 'Current University' column is the affiliation when the page was last updated (9/20/2017), recorded in destination; it is not a first placement and no position is given. Division codes (FIN, ACC, MIS, OB, MKT, SC, ULE, POL, IB, TRA) are kept in note; SC appears to be the management science / operations division. E-mail addresses printed beside names were omitted. Degree 'PhD' is taken from the page title; program from the breadcrumb 'PhD in Business Administration'.
